description: Codex: Space Marines (11e) Space Wolves CHAMPION'S GUIDANCE (Champions of Fenris, 1 CP) — WP-S3. Fixture sw11e_s3_active (P1 Space Wolves ACTIVE vs P2 Orks, round 2; layout in tests/helpers/gen_sw11e_s3_fixtures.gd). Setup privileges: the Space Wolves player gets all three Space Wolves detachments (stratagems reloaded), auto wound allocation, the Ork player has 0 CP (no Ork stratagem windows — not under test), straight to the phase under test. A real click on Logan Grimnar (ADEPTUS ASTARTES CHARACTER, engaged with the Warboss) in the fight list opens unit_selected_to_fight; a real click on 'Use on Logan Grimnar' spends 1 CP; his melee attacks re-roll hit rolls of 1 and wound rolls of 1 (the resolved hit and wound dice blocks name Champion's Guidance); the fight resolves.
